note: Rustic campground on the south shore of Gemini Lake, 16.8 miles northeast of Shingleton via H-15, H-58, H-52 and County Road 454; the last stretch is sand/dirt forest road, passable in dry conditions. Less than 10 miles from Pictured Rocks National Lakeshore; the 1.5-mile Gemini Pathway starts here, with carry-in access between sites 4 and 5. A 28-ft Class C was firsthand-reported fitting site 4. ORVs and snowmobiles may ride between the campground and nearby trails (Trail 8 adjacent). --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: $20, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 8 sites (confirmed, derived -> manual); max stay changed 14 -> 15 days. Season 'open all year' already manual, left. Type 'rustic', not equestrian; ORV and snowmobile operation between campground and trails allowed (Trail 8 adjacent), but it is not described as an ORV trail camp. 'Tents and small trailers' is the standard wording (silent on length). No road warning on the page. Note trimmed; 'Managing office: DNR Shingleton FMU' dropped (the DNR lists Indian Lake SP).
